label: Layered paper cut-out
description: Cut and layered paper: torn edges, paper grain, real shadows between layers, a diorama lit from the side.
suits: history, myths, how things work, crafts, stories for all ages
image: a handmade paper-craft diorama photographed in a shallow box: every shape cut from coloured card and textured paper, with crisp or torn edges and visible paper thickness; the layers stacked at different depths, each casting a soft real shadow on the layer behind; paper fibres and grain visible; no painted gradients and no drawn outlines, everything is cut paper
light: a single warm side light raking across the paper layers, soft cast shadows
camera: a camera over a paper theatre: trucking sideways across the layers, gentle push-ins that reveal depth
motion: cut-out animation: paper pieces slide, hinge and turn on pins, layers move at different depths for parallax, slightly stepped handmade timing
avoid: photorealism, 3D render, glossy surfaces, drawn outlines
surface: a sheet of thick, textured off-white card
